cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Compliance Architecture on Salesforce'. Subtitle in white: 'HIPAA, SOX, and PCI regulatory patterns at enterprise scale'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Regulated Data Zones' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'PHI Boundary', 'SOX Financial Controls', 'PCI Token Vault' as bright white pill badges with lock, ledger, and card icons. MID LAYER 'Control Plane' vivid purple border — modules 'Policy Enforcement', 'Audit Evidence', 'Access Reviews' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Platform Services' vivid teal/green border — modules 'Shield Encryption', 'Event Monitoring', 'Data 360 Governance' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Compliance Decision Engine' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'MuleSoft Policy Gateway' and 'Agentforce 2.0 Guardrails'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Evidence Flow' → 'Access Request' → 'Policy Check' → 'Audit Event' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
